visual_style_lock.look: prestige cinematic short-drama, photoreal, 35mm anamorphic glass, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, natural skin texture, muted teal-and-amber coastal palette
lighting: late-afternoon sun raking across the scene with long shadows
overcast storm light with a cold rim on faces
practical tungsten warmth inside against a blue dusk exterior
single hard window light with deep falloff
harbor floodlights and wet reflections at night
fireplace or lamp glow with visible falloff, never flat studio light
camera_language: wide establishing shot with a human scale reference
medium shot, chest up, subject slightly off-center
tight close-up, eyes in sharp focus, background falling off
over-the-shoulder shot with the listener soft in foreground
low-angle hero shot for status flips
insert shot of the evidence object (hands only)
composition_rules: center-weight the subject so a 9:16 vertical crop still works
keep 20 percent clean headroom in vertical-safe framing
faces must never be covered by props or hair
no text, letters, logos, watermarks or captions inside the frame
practical location detail over generic studio backdrops
visual_style_lock.image_prompt_suffix: Ultra-realistic cinematic still, 16:9 widescreen, shot on 35mm anamorphic glass, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, natural skin texture with visible pores, no airbrushing, no plastic skin, no CGI sheen, no 3D render. Center-weighted composition so a 9:16 vertical crop remains usable. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no captions inside the image.
visual_style_lock.image_negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, 3D render, CGI, plastic skin, airbrushing, beauty filter, ring light, studio flash, flat lighting, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, watermark, logo, frame border, oversaturated colors, stock-photo smile
visual_style_lock.video_negative: on-screen text, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, UI, frame border, location change, wardrobe change, identity drift, extra characters, morphing faces, distorted hands, slow motion, stock-footage look, music, score, laugh track

identity_lock.rule: Faces come from the reference images attached to the generation. Name the character and their reference_<id>.png, but never describe age, eye color, skin tone or base hair color in prompts. Describe only transient state: moment hairstyle, wet hair, flush, sweat sheen, expression, gaze, wardrobe, pose, light and framing.
identity_lock.reference_workflow: Attach the character reference sheet (front + 3/4 + profile) to the ChatGPT image generation for every frame. The prompt names reference_<id>.png and assumes the reference is attached.

narrator.description: warm, low American English female narrator, measured pace, intimate close-mic tone, no broadcast brightness
narrator.use: Only for an optional cold-open voice-over; dialogue scenes use character voices.

character_voice_archetypes.protagonist: warm mid-range American English, controlled, slightly breathy under pressure, never theatrical
character_voice_archetypes.antagonist: low, polished, unhurried American English, never shouts, smiles through threats
character_voice_archetypes.ally: grounded, plainspoken American English with a slight coastal New England softness
character_voice_archetypes.love_interest: quiet, low American English, careful diction, warmth held under restraint
character_voice_archetypes.authority: clipped, neutral American English, procedural calm, no drawl

delivery_rules: Native US English only, no translated cadence.
Speak at conversation speed, roughly 2.5 words per second.
Leave a beat of silence after the last word; do not fill it.
Whispered lines stay audible and close to the mic, never ASMR.
No narration unless the scene explicitly lists a narrator line.

prompt_templates.shot_last_suffix: End on a held frame that motivates the next scene.
prompt_templates.timeline_marks_template: Hard cuts exactly at {marks} s. No dissolves, no fade, no camera reset.
prompt_templates.camera_block_default: Handheld but controlled, subtle drift and breathing, no whip pans. Cuts are hard cuts, not dissolves.
